text:
10. 1. 10

Dutiyasukkā suttaṃ. 

244. Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandaka nivāpe. tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako sukkāya bhikkhuniyā bhojanaṃ adāsi. Atha kho sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:

Puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ sappañño vatāyamūpāsako, 

Yo sukkāya adāsi bhojanaṃ sabbaganthehi vippamuttāyāti.
